definitions.explanation: Describes applying pressure or effort with determination.
Used to emphasize a significant increase or improvement.
Describes being emotionally moved or touched.

examples.japanese: ぐっと⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦{押|お}す→押す：02854_osu⟧。
examples.english: To push with all one's strength.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歯|は}→歯：00778_ha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ぐっと⟦{食|く}いしばった→食いしばる：14624_kuishibaru⟧。
⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ぐっと⟦こらえて→堪える：08995_koraeru⟧⟦{笑顔|えがお}→笑顔：01884_egao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せた→見せる：01988_miseru⟧。
examples.english: I held back my tears and showed a smile.

examples.japanese: ⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぐっと⟦{下|さ}がった→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧。
⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧ぐっと⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: After practicing, I got much better.

examples.english: I was deeply moved by that story.

notes:
ぐっと is a mimetic word (⟦{擬態語|ぎたいご}→擬態語：22468_gitaigo⟧) with three main uses: physical force, significant degree, and emotional impact.

SENSE 1 — PHYSICAL FORCE:
- ぐっと⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to put in effort/force
- ぐっと⟦{我慢|がまん}→我慢：00057_gaman⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to hold back firmly
- ぐっと⟦こらえる→堪える：08995_koraeru⟧: to endure, to hold in

SENSE 2 — SIGNIFICANT DEGREE:
- ぐっと⟦{良|よ}く→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to get much better
- ぐっと⟦{下|さ}がる→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧: to drop significantly
- ぐっと⟦{近|ちか}づく→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧: to come much closer

SENSE 3 — EMOTIONAL IMPACT:
- ぐっと⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧: to be moved, to be touched
- ぐっと⟦{胸|むね}→胸：00972_mune⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{迫|せま}る→迫る：03928_semaru⟧: to tug at the heartstrings

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ぎゅっと→ぎゅっと：05355_gyutto⟧: tightly squeezing (physical pressure)
- ⟦きゅっと→きゅっと：05354_kyutto⟧: with a quick, tight squeeze
- がっ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: forcefully, suddenly (rougher nuance)
- ⟦ぐんと→ぐんと：noentry⟧: significantly, by a lot (similar to sense 2, but less emotional)
